internalName: Villa Peninsula — beachfront 1st-row villas (Green Frog · Plai Laem)
place: Plai Laem, Bo Phut, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Absolute-Beachfront Two- & Three-Bedroom Pool Villas at Plai Laem
blurb: An ultra-limited collection of just nine beachfront villas on the sand at Plai Laem, Koh Samui's high-end north-east cape. Single-level two- and three-bedroom pool villas in a Mediterranean idiom of white render and stone, opening straight to the beach and the sunset. Fully furnished and turnkey, on a registered 30-year lease with professional rental management and a projected ~13% return. From ฿15,990,000.
detail:
A rare stretch of true beachfront on Plai Laem, the prestigious north-east cape of Koh Samui, this is an intimate collection of only nine villas set directly on the sand — with private beach access and open views west across the Gulf to the sunset. Fisherman's Village and Chaweng are about five minutes away, the airport around fifteen.

THE VILLAS
The first-row villas are single-level homes of two or three bedrooms, arranged around a private infinity pool that runs toward the sea. Open-plan living and kitchen space flows out to a covered sea-view terrace with sunbeds, sofa and dining; each bedroom has a king bed, built-in wardrobe and en-suite bathroom. The architecture is Mediterranean in spirit — white render, concrete and stone, framed by tropical gardens — and every villa is delivered fully furnished and turnkey. The pools are 3 × 7.3 m in Bali stone, 1.2 m deep, with an integrated sun shelf.

INVESTMENT
Each villa is built for rental from day one and can be placed under a fully integrated management programme run by a professional operator. On the developer's conservative model — comparable beachfront villas at around 65% occupancy — projected net returns run to roughly 13%.

OWNERSHIP & DEVELOPER
The villas are sold leasehold on a 30-year lease registered at the Land Office in the buyer's name, transferable and renewable, with the lease payable every five years. The development is by Green Frog Samui, an established island builder of more than a decade, and carries a 5-year structural warranty. Completion is scheduled for Q4 2027.

PRICES
2-Bedroom Beachfront (1st row) — ≈90 m² indoor · 320 m² plot — ฿15,990,000
3-Bedroom Beachfront (1st row) — ≈115 m² indoor · 345 m² plot — ฿19,990,000

PAYMENT PLAN
A staged plan from reservation to handover:
15% — On signing the reservation agreement
30% — On signing the lease & construction agreement
20% — Start of construction (foundations & structural framework)
20% — Main structure (walls, roof, waterproofing, electrical & plumbing)
10% — Exterior works & interior finishes
5% — Final inspection & handover
A mandatory estate-maintenance contract of ฿3,000 per month covers the well, private road, beach and landscaped areas.
